statement: Copy content in materials with "Copy Material"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Create new content in materials with "New Material"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Paste previously copied content in materials with "Paste Material"; the pasted items match what was copied, land where Blender 5.3 puts them, and one undo step removes them.
